Write the whole-module specification

module origen_052936 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    
    // Port A (Write Port)
    input wire [31:0] addra,
    input wire clka,
    input wire [31:0] dina,
    output wire [31:0] douta,
    input wire ena,
    input wire rsta,
    input wire [3:0] wea,
    
    // Port B (Read Port)
    input wire [31:0] addrb,
    input wire clkb,
    input wire [31:0] dinb,
    output reg [31:0] doutb,
    input wire enb,
    input wire rstb,
    input wire [3:0] web
);

    reg [2:0] i;
    reg [4:0] cnt, cnt1;
    reg [31:0] addr_a, addr_b;
    reg [31:0] data_in;
    reg en_a, en_b;
    reg [3:0] we_a;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            i <= 0;
            cnt <= 0;
            cnt1 <= 0;
            addr_a <= 0;
            addr_b <= 0;
            data_in <= 0;
            en_a <= 0;
            en_b <= 0;
            we_a <= 4'b0000;
            doutb <= 32'h0;
        end else begin
            case (i)
                0: begin // Initialization
                    en_a <= 1;
                    we_a <= 4'b1111;
                    i <= 1;
                end
                1: begin // Write Operation
                    if (cnt < 10) begin
                        if (cnt1 == 0) begin
                            addr_a <= addr_a + 1;
                            data_in <= data_in + 10;
                        end
                        if (cnt1 == 4) begin
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                            cnt1 <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            cnt1 <= cnt1 + 1;
                        end
                    end else begin
                        i <= 2;
                        cnt <= 0;
                    end
                end
                2: begin // Transition to Read
                    we_a <= 4'b0000;
                    en_b <= 1;
                    i <= 3;
                end
                3: begin // Read Operation
                    if (cnt < 10) begin
                        addr_b <= addr_b + 1;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end else begin
                        i <= 4;
                        cnt <= 0;
                    end
                end
                4: begin // Read Reset
                    addr_b <= 0;
                    i <= 3;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    // RAM instantiation would go here
    // For this example, we'll just connect the signals
    assign addra = addr_a;
    assign dina = data_in;
    assign addrb = addr_b;

endmodule
